rules.description: Apex China traffic directly to www Chinese documentation
rules.expression: (http.host eq "midscenejs.com") and ip.src.country eq "CN" and not (http.request.uri.path eq "/zh" or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/zh/")) and not (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/images/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/static/") or http.request.uri.path in {"/favicon.ico" "/favicon.png" "/og-image.png" "/robots.txt" "/sitemap.xml" "/sitemap-index.xml" "/apple-touch-icon.png" "/apple-touch-icon-precomposed.png"})

rules.description: Apex Chinese homepage directly to canonical www homepage
All remaining apex traffic to HTTPS www, preserving paths
